what: Planned stdout assertion treats write-tally output as only LOG_WRITTEN
scenario_or_breakage: write_tally_main re-emits every KEY=value from run-log write, and run-log write also emits LOG_PATH, BYTES, SHA256, COMMIT_SHA, and UNCHANGED; an exact single-line stdout assertion would fail or force needless stubbing
suggested_fix: Assert warning text is absent from stdout, require LOG_WRITTEN=true, and assert every stdout line is KEY=value rather than expecting only LOG_WRITTEN
